entities.summary: Hope Dworaczyk Smith is an American entrepreneur, model, and reality television personality. She is the founder and CEO of MUTHA, a skincare company, and was the host of Inside Fashion. Smith was Playboy magazine's Playmate of the Month for April 2009, and later became the 2010 Playmate of the Year.
